tool_trajectory.result: The "least efficient rank" refers to the worst EER rank within each application type, which is calculated using the PERCENT_RANK function over the EER values, partitioned by application type and ordered in descending order.

args.sql:
SELECT
    t2.apptypeval AS application_type,
    AVG(
        (t1.energyusekwhval / NULLIF(t1.pwrfactorval, 0))
    ) AS average_eer,
    MIN(
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t2.apptypeval
            ORDER BY (t1.energyusekwhval / NULLIF(t1.pwrfactorval, 0)) DESC
        )
    ) AS least_efficient_rank
FROM
    performance_and_safety AS t1
JOIN
    operation AS t2 ON t1.effectivenessoperation = t2.operreg
GROUP BY
    t2.apptypeval
ORDER BY
    average_eer ASC;
